key_insight: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) recovers exact ground-state energies for low-energy FeO and Fe₂O₂ model Hamiltonians with few quantum computational resources.
engineering_relevance: Combining ab initio-informed low-energy models with SQD offers a potential route to studying strongly correlated materials on existing quantum hardware.
method: Construct low-energy model Hamiltonians for molecular FeO and Fe₂O₂.
Benchmark Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and SQD against classical exact diagonalization.
Apply SQD with two connectivity shells to recover ground-state energies.
evidence_signal: The study recovers FeO’s experimental quintet ground state and a nonet ground state for Fe₂O₂; raw VQE misses chemical accuracy, while two-shell SQD matches exact model ground-state energies.
watch_item: Results concern molecular model Hamiltonians, not a demonstrated bulk FeO calculation; scalability to larger solid-state models remains to be established.
paper_title: Towards Quantum Computation of Bulk FeO
